Every Parasol claim moves through four workflow statuses. Submitted means the claim has been received but not yet assigned. UnderReview means an adjuster has been assigned and is evaluating the claim and its documents. Approved means the claim has been accepted and is scheduled for payment. Denied means the claim was rejected, for example because the loss falls outside policy coverage.

Once a claim is Approved, Parasol issues payment within 5 business days. Auto and home claim payments are made to the policyholder (or directly to an approved repair shop on request); life claim payments are made to the named beneficiary. Payment is net of any unpaid deductible.

A home property claim requires an itemized list of damaged or lost property, dated photographs of the damage, and receipts or proof of ownership for high-value items. Parasol may send an adjuster to inspect the property before approving claims above 10000 USD.

After a claim is filed it receives a claim number of the form CLM-1234 and is assigned to an adjuster. The adjuster reviews the documents, may ask for a repair estimate from an approved workshop, and recommends a settlement. Payouts above the adjuster's authority are approved by a claims manager.
